lines.zh: 我贴着叶脉爬，一步一耸背。
lines.en: I crawl along the leaf vein, back humping with each step.

lines.zh: 八条小脚抓住叶面，走得很稳。
lines.en: Eight little legs hold the leaf face and I walk steady.
The leaf edge arrives. I turn.

lines.zh: 我啃出一道洞，钻到叶脉对面。
lines.en: I chew a hole and crawl through to the other side of the vein.
I chew my way forward step by step.
This one leaf is my whole road.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶缘挪到另一边。
lines.en: I move along the rim to the other side.
The leaf sways beneath me.

lines.zh: 我把脸探出去，找不到下一片。
lines.en: I poke my head out and find no next leaf.
I bunch up and stretch out again.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉上走成一条线。
lines.en: I keep to a line along the vein.
The leaf hairs scrape my feet.
I am heading for the leaf tip.
An inch of crawl, an inch of leaf, an inch of road.
Where I have chewed there are holes.

lines.zh: 我停下来，找另一片叶子。
lines.en: I stop to look for another leaf.
I stop at the leaf center and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶子，我身上有斑。
lines.en: Sun through the leaf puts spots on me.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，闻了闻空气。
lines.en: I lift my front half and taste the air.

lines.zh: 这片叶子快被我吃完了。
lines.en: This leaf is nearly eaten through.
I hump my back and hold still.
A bird's shadow slid over.
I press myself flat.

lines.zh: 叶子上的露水打湿了我。
lines.en: Dew on the leaf has soaked me.
My feet hold the leaf face.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，看另一边。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to look the other way.

lines.zh: 风一吹，整片叶子都动了。
lines.en: The wind moves the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我在等叶子上多一点光。
lines.en: I wait for more light on the leaf.
I grip the leaf edge and don't dare move.
Are you a leaf?

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，才看得见你。
lines.en: I must rear up to see you.
Do not touch me. I will fall.

lines.zh: 我这条命，全拴在这片叶上。
lines.en: My life is tied to this leaf.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我的身体宽。
lines.en: Your finger is wider than my body.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，够不到你的指尖。
lines.en: I rear up but cannot reach your fingertip.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，叶子凉了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and the leaf grows cold.

lines.zh: 我要是掉下去，就爬不上来了。
lines.en: If I fall I cannot climb back.

lines.zh: 你想把我搬到别的叶子上。
lines.en: You want to move me to another leaf.
This yellow body hides under leaves.

lines.zh: 黄皮破了一处，渗出绿水。
lines.en: My yellow skin splits and green fluid oozes out.
I fell to the underside of the leaf.
Some green fluid has leaked out of me.
I hold on and slowly recover.
After that I could not move for a while.
My feet are still here, just shaking.
I did not fall. Lucky.
I made myself even smaller.
I am still on the leaf, still alive.
Is that a leaf? Bring it here.

lines.zh: 我只吃这个，别的都不吃。
lines.en: I eat only this, and nothing else.
That leaf looks tender.
One sniff: that is not a leaf.
I bite and cannot get through.
I have never eaten such a thing.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放我面前就行。
lines.en: Just put the leaf in front of me.
This one leaf could last me a day.
I do not eat cooked things. Only raw.
If the leaf is not fresh, I refuse it.
One touch and I curl up.
I grip the leaf face and do not fall.
Do not push the leaf with your finger.
I rolled half a turn and caught hold again.
That shake nearly dropped me.

lines.zh: 我在叶子背面，碰不到你。
lines.en: I am under the leaf where you cannot reach.

lines.zh: 你踩的不是我，是那根树枝。
lines.en: You stepped on a branch, not on me.
My feet are small but they hold.

lines.zh: 你让叶子晃得太厉害了。
lines.en: You are shaking the leaf too much.

lines.zh: 我的脚黏在叶面，滑了半步。
lines.en: My feet cling to the leaf but slip half a step.
That is a long way off for me.
I am only a caterpillar.

lines.zh: 树上还有别的毛虫，条纹不一样。
lines.en: There are other caterpillars on this tree, striped differently.

lines.zh: 我们不碰面，各吃各的叶。
lines.en: We never meet. Each eats its own leaf.

lines.zh: 有一条爬到了我旁边的叶子。
lines.en: One crawled onto the leaf beside mine.

lines.zh: 我们隔着叶脉看了一会儿。
lines.en: We looked at each other across a vein.
It left and I went back to eating.

lines.zh: 等我们都长出翅膀再说。
lines.en: Let us speak when we both have wings.

lines.zh: 那时候我就不认得它了。
lines.en: By then I will not know it.
Caterpillars do not remember caterpillars.

lines.zh: 地上有片落叶，我够不到。
lines.en: A fallen leaf lies out of reach.

lines.zh: 我用前脚拨了一下叶屑。
lines.en: I brush a fleck of leaf with a front leg.
This little thing is not a leaf.
I push it away and keep eating.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水珠，我喝了一口。
lines.en: A drop of water on the leaf. I drink.
I cannot carry anything away.
This torn bit of leaf. I eat it.

lines.zh: 下面有个亮东西，我看不清。
lines.en: Something bright below. I cannot make it out.

lines.zh: 我身上粘了一片小叶子。
lines.en: A small leaf has stuck to me.

lines.zh: 东西掉到地上了，我下不去。
lines.en: It fell to the ground and I cannot go down.
A fresh leaf ahead.
I smell young leaf.
I raise my head and take the direction.
That twig is very close.

lines.zh: 我要过去，得先爬过叶柄。
lines.en: To get there I must cross the stem.
I reach out a little at a time.
There is no gap left ahead.
I stretch as far as I can.
My front feet have touched the new leaf.
I have finally crossed over.
I have measured this gap.

lines.zh: 我咬住叶尖，往另一片叶挪。
lines.en: I bite the leaf tip and shift toward the next leaf.
Nothing below it. I must not fall.
I grip the stem with my rear feet.
The twig swayed.
The caterpillar clings to the vein, waiting out the wind.
The wind stopped. I move.
An inch at a time. No rush.

lines.zh: 我的身体架在两片叶子之间。
lines.en: My body bridges the two leaves.
Half a body length to go.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，摆出姿势。
lines.en: I rear my front half into a pose.
I let out a sticky thread.
I butt my head against the leaf rim.
This much force will not matter to you.
I twist and sway my body.

lines.zh: 我把背拱起来，像要扑过去。
lines.en: I arch my back as if to spring.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，咬的是叶子。
lines.en: I bite. I bite the leaf.
I flail my front legs.
I rolled once and pushed back up.
I doubt this counts as a threat.
I chewed my way out of an egg.

lines.zh: 这片叶子就是我的第一顿饭。
lines.en: This leaf is my first meal.
I am still damp.
I crawl a few steps and stop.
There is a yellow stripe on my head.

lines.zh: 叶子在风里晃，我抓得很紧。
lines.en: The leaf sways and I hold on hard.
I hear the sounds of the wood.
I picked this leaf to settle on.
The sun reached me and warmed.
I take my first bite.
The heat made me curl up.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，摔在土上。
lines.en: I dropped off the leaf onto the soil.

lines.zh: 露水把我淹住了，我挣不动。
lines.en: Dew drowned me and I could not move.
The blast shook the leaf wildly.
Something grazed my back.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光让我全身发麻。
lines.en: Strange light numbed my whole body.
The leaf is gone and I am starving.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我抖得停不下来。
lines.en: The thunder was so loud I could not stop shaking.

lines.zh: 丛林叶影没了，我的小脚乱抓。
lines.en: The jungle leaves are gone; my little feet grasp at nothing.
